# Test fixtures

- `detector-ai-claude.jsonl`: 16 academic-style paragraphs written by a Claude model for this project (MIT, like the code).
- `hape-acad-sample.jsonl`: 20 academic passages from the held-out test documents of the Human-AI Parallel English
  corpus (HAP-E, Reinhart et al., https://huggingface.co/datasets/browndw/human-ai-parallel-corpus, MIT licence):
  10 human continuations and 10 GPT-4o continuations of the same openings. GPT-4o was not used in training.
- `sample.docx`, `sample.pdf`: tiny documents for extraction tests, generated for this project.
- `humanise.docx`, `humanise.pdf`: a short paper (a Word file and the same file saved as PDF by LibreOffice) for the
  Humaniser's File mode, written for this project.
